content.text: : prevents insertion of a DNA copy of the viral genome into the host DNA
:  inhibits viral replication by interfering w/ HIV viral RNA-dependent DNA polymerase
Abacavir: CI if + HLA-B*5701 allele because of ↑ risk of hypersensitivity rxn
These agents are not active against already infected cells, but reduce viral ability to infect other cells

: metabolic effects (hyperglycemia/insulin resistance, dyslipidemia, increased body fat, lipodystrophy), increased CVD risk, hepatic effects (transaminase elevation, exacerbate pre-existing hepatic dysfunction), hypersensitivity reactions (rash, anaphylaxis, angioedema, bronchospasm, erythema multiforme, SJS/TEN), N/D
: use w/ caution in hepatic disease
